disambiguation: Not a general Markdown editor; it is a specialized tool for translating Obsidian content into LaTeX format.
extras: Requires specific setup including Python, latexmk, BRAT, and QuickAdd. Uses a 'note-block logic' for complex referencing.
motivation: The author wants users to be able to seamlessly write formal content in the same software as their notes and print it from there, without needing to move to external software.
problem: The difficulty of writing formal scientific or academic documents entirely within Obsidian while maintaining links, structure, and seamless output to LaTeX.

relations.evidence: add this repository (MariosGkMeng/Straightforward-Obsidian2Latex) in the BRAT plugin.
Can keep your report/publication/book/etc connected to your note-taking ecosystem, instead of having to move around to an external source.

requires.name: full LaTeX distribution (MiKTeX or TeX Live)

summary: A converter that translates Obsidian Markdown notes into LaTeX code and compiles them into PDF documents, supporting complex features like embedded notes and dataview parameterization.
